name: Atomic Slider Addons for Elementor
author: WP Caliph

sections.description:
Atomic Slider Addons for Elementor is a feature-rich plugin crafted to supercharge the Elementor page builder with advanced slider widgets that are powerful, flexible, and easy to use.

Perfect for bloggers, marketers, business owners, and WooCommerce users, Atomic Slider lets you create visually stunning, fully responsive sliders that increase engagement and elevate your website’s design.

Key Features

✅ Image Carousel Widget – A modern Swiper effect that makes your slides come alive.

Atomic Slider extends Elementor with lightweight, performance-focused widgets that enhance creativity and usability — without slowing down your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the atomic-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Elementor editor and start using the new slider widgets.
sections.faq:
What do I need to use this plugin?

Just install Atomic Slider along with Elementor. Once activated, the plugin provides all essential slider widgets directly in the Elementor editor.

How do I get support if I face an issue?

Open a support thread on the plugin’s WordPress.org support forum. Our team will follow up as soon as possible.

How do I receive updates?

When a new version is released, WordPress will notify you on the Plugins page. You can update directly from there like any other plugin.
